description: Generador gráfico de tablas para LaTeX, Markdown y Typst — Reox Lab
name: tablex

scripts.test: for f in tests/test-*.ts; do esbuild "$f" --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:xlsx --outfile=./.tmp-test.mjs --log-level=error && node ./.tmp-test.mjs || exit 1; done; rm -f ./.tmp-test.mjs
